title: Aromatic Indian Prawns Palak Paneer
description: A tangy and flavorful Indian dish featuring raw king prawns, paneer cheese, and a rich palak sauce, perfect for a lazy Sunday lunch. This recipe is also anti-inflammatory friendly and features a double-fry KFC style coating on the prawns.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the cumin seeds and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic and saute until fragrant.
Add the spinach puree, garam masala, coriander powder, turmeric powder, and red chili powder, and stir well.
Add the paneer cheese cubes and stir gently to combine with the spinach sauce.
In a separate pan, heat the remaining oil over medium-high heat and double-fry the prawns until they are golden brown and crispy.
Add the fried prawns to the spinach sauce and stir gently to combine.
Reduce heat to low and let the dish simmer for a few minutes to allow the flavors to meld together.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro or scallions if desired.
